race.comment: BENNELONG TIME (1) has the right profile after improving sharply from a sound debut to win a Mdn at this track last start, beating Lull Us Away by a nose as a well-supported favourite. He is still lightly raced, already proven at this venue, and should take further benefit third-up. RED LIGHT RACHEL (7) earned respect by winning at Wangaratta over this trip at generous odds. Can go on with the job on the NSW side of the border. RIVAZZA (8) is knocking on the door and can't be discounted with the in-form apprentice on board. HIGH YIELD (11) steps straight up to the mile at start 2 but finds a suitable race and won't be far away.
